text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning and self-awareness. First, time management is essential: create a schedule and break large tasks into smaller steps. Second, prioritization helps you focus on what matters most, so you finish important work before less urgent tasks. Third, scope management means being realistic about what you can actually complete. If a task is too big, reduce it or ask for help instead of trying to do everything. Finally, communication is key. If you realize you may miss a deadline, tell your teacher, manager, or team early. Honest updates build trust, and people can often adjust plans or offer support before problems become serious.
